scope: Independent inspection of actual exported/reimported GLB Cycles CPU images after the focused broadleaf quality revision. No full-realism or runtime-comparison claim.

checks.nearBroadleafOpaqueBlobRemoval: pass: zero opaque foliage triangles in both LOD0 broadleaf models

findings: Maple and alder LOD0 are now built from outer and inner atlas-masked clusters. The smooth bright opaque crown blobs seen in version 1 are absent; small leaves and branch gaps define the crown.
The revision keeps the same dimensions, branch skeleton and texture set. All ten unaffected GLBs are byte-identical to version 1.
LOD1 and LOD2 remain deliberately coarse opaque aggregate proxies. Their brightness/density changes are visible in the side-by-side close display and require actual city-distance transition testing.
The conifer LOD0 layering is unchanged. Fine needles, night readability and mip behavior still require the city renderer.
More triangles now use alpha masking. CPU images do not establish GPU overdraw, texture residency delta or frame-time improvement.
